heur_ev.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by E[NPV]

heur_ce.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by CE (oracle)

rn.label: risk-neutral two-stage MIP at the strip

rn_lp_round.label: greedy rounding of the risk-neutral LP relaxation (RN-LP rounding)

rn_deck.label: risk-neutral MIP at the oracle-selected planning deck (best CE under the true model; grid 0.5-1.1 by 0.025; best 1.0); time includes rn

ce_cold.label: certified CE solver, cold start (wall-clock = fair solver time)

ce.label: certified CE solver seeded with rn, rn_lp_round, heur_ce (time includes the seeds)

ce_1round.label: one OA round from the rn seed, 30 s master (time includes rn)

pso_long.label: binary PSO on ce, 1 seed(s) x 300 s, recourse rule = cfg of heur_ce

rn_size.label: risk-neutral MIP with expected wells <= the CE plan's (size-matched; the size is an oracle input, time includes ce)

rn_tilt1.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, one fixed-point iteration from the rn plan (no oracle; time includes rn)

rn_tilt2.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, two fixed-point iterations from the rn plan (no oracle; time includes rn and rn_tilt1)

rn_tilt.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP at the CE plan's softmax weights (oracle: the linear part of the final OA cut, without its exposure and CGF terms; time includes ce)

ce_gauss.label: certified plan under the seed's Gaussian (second-cumulant) per-well treatment, scored under the exact model (time includes rn)

heur_ce+exact_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ce, recourse re-optimized to a certificate

rn_deck+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn_deck, recourse re-optimized to a certificate

rn+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn, recourse re-optimized to a certificate

mv+exact_recourse.label: deterministic mean-value first stage (theta = P = 1, risk-neutral), certified CE recourse (the v3.1 EEV rung; mixes the stochastic model with the risk model)

mv_rn.label: mean-value first stage (theta = P = 1, risk-neutral) with risk-neutral recourse on the tree: the rolling deterministic re-solve (time includes the mean-value solve)

mv_ce+exact_recourse.label: CE mean-value first stage (solve_ce at theta = P = 1 and the same lambda), certified CE recourse on the tree (time includes the mean-value solves)

ce_fs+rn_recourse.label: the CE plan's first stage with risk-neutral recourse

ce_committed.label: certified CE plan with one recourse shared by all nodes (committed)

plan_format.encoding: z0/zk: positions in idx0/idx1; y: packages; w0: units; wk: per node, u * (T - 1) + (t - 1)
